articles.title: Letters: Warren Avenue Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I have lived on Warren Avenue for 6 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made.
Please keep the playground upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Warren Avenue use it every week.
Alma Haddad, Kettle Hill

articles.title: Wanda Vance, 89, Church Organist
articles.deck: Friends remember Wanda Vance for the many years of service to Hickory Ridge.
body: Born in Hickory Ridge in the years after the war, Wanda Vance spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Hickory Ridge. Wanda Vance died in April at home on Briar Drive, at the age of 89.
